own_G1_rank_target_theorem.c44_case: At least5 nontrivial kernel dimensions, including the two forced star differences. Thus at least3 additional nontrivial relations in total, counting any already found.
own_G1_rank_target_theorem.minimal_targets: Ten overlapping minimal threshold patterns(1+a,1+b,c) with a+b+c=3. A rank30 candidate necessarily satisfies at least one of them; the patterns alone do not prove rank30 or positivity.
own_G1_rank_target_theorem.scope: Only the local G1-invariant family. No assumption that G1 extends to automorphisms of a full Conway graph.
own_G1_rank_target_theorem.validation: Exact group action, eleven regular orbits, character orthogonality, two-star orbit counts and forced star types; no graph input read.
